senses.gloss:
क्लैब्य or क्लैव्य, अम्, n. absence of virility,
impotence, unmanly behaviour, unmanliness, weak-
ness, timidity, cowardice; the neuter gender.
क्लैब्य क्लैब्य or क्लैव्य. See under क्लीब.

क्लैतकिक क्लैतकिक, अम्, n. a fermented
liquor prepared from the root of the plant Klītaka
(क्लीतकिका?), wine, spirituous liquor.
